short_description: Contemporary Pakistani couture — luxury lawn, pret and bridal.
long_description: Founded in Karachi, Sana Safinaz is known for signature prints, chikankari and cotton net dupattas. Elite Brands stocks the seasonal lawn, luxury pret and formal collections.

short_description: House of Maria B — lawn, formals and bridal wear.
long_description: Maria B blends modern silhouettes with rooted eastern craft. Expect hand-embroidered lawn, ready-to-wear kurtas and occasion formals.

short_description: Heritage Pakistani textile house — lawn, unstitched and pret.
long_description: One of Pakistan's oldest textile houses, Gul Ahmed is trusted for consistent fabric quality across everyday unstitched and festive collections.

short_description: Handwoven fabrics and eastern-western fusion wear.
long_description: Khaadi's identity is handloom. The collection ranges from everyday pret to statement embroidered pieces in signature earth tones.

short_description: Modern minimalist Pakistani ready-to-wear and lawn.
long_description: Sapphire pairs clean tailoring with restrained prints. Ideal for the customer who wants understated eastern wear.

short_description: Signature florals and vintage-inspired luxury lawn.
long_description: Zara Shahjahan is known for romantic florals, block prints and painterly embroidery across luxury lawn and formal edits.
Elan specialises in intricate hand embellishment, French knots and pearl work — reserved for bridal and formal occasions.
Sania Maskatiya blends print, embroidery and modern cuts for a distinctly editorial eastern wardrobe.

short_description: Everyday and festive unstitched and pret.
long_description: From the Nishat Mills group, Nishat Linen offers dependable seasonal collections at accessible price points.

short_description: Luxury lawn, chiffon and formal couture.
long_description: Asim Jofa is recognised for fine embroidery on chiffon and organza, alongside a signature luxury lawn line.

short_description: Modern bridal and luxury formals in signature pastels.
long_description: Faiza Saqlain's atelier focuses on soft palettes, delicate embellishment and contemporary bridal silhouettes.
Mushq brings romantic prints and modern eastern cuts to both unstitched and ready-to-wear.
Bareeze is a legacy house known for classic embroidered fabric suits, dupattas and modest silhouettes.

short_description: Culturally rooted Pakistani pret with playful prints.
long_description: Generation champions Pakistani craft and heritage through modern, print-driven ready-to-wear.

short_description: Accessible unstitched lawn and pret for every day.
long_description: Cross Stitch offers everyday and festive unstitched and pret with a strong price-to-quality balance.
